description: Voigtländer于1951年推出的旁轴相机。配备coated Ultron 50mm f2.0 (6 elements in 4 groups) 15 blade diaphragm.。快门速度T, B, 1, 2, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100, 250 or 300. 500 was available in some models with Compur shutter。使用135mm (24x36mm image)。

specs.英文简介: The Vito III is a 35mm rangefinder camera that was first produced by Voigtländer in 1950, this camera was the high-end model of the Vito family, with a better lens, shutter and rangefinder.
